metadata.content:
*You control an enemy's nervous system. How pleasant for them.*

| **Psionic, [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged), Telepathy** |  **Main action** |
|--------------------------------|-----------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged) 10**               | **🎯 One enemy** |

**[Power Roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) + [Reason](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/reason):**

- **≤11:** The target makes a [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike) against one enemy of your choice.
- **12-16:** The target shifts up to their [speed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/speed) and uses their [signature ability](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/signature-ability) against any enemies of your choice.
- **17+:** The target moves up to their [speed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/speed) and uses their [signature ability](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/signature-ability) against any enemies of your choice.

**Effect:** You control the target's movement. The target can't be moved in a way that would harm them (such as over a cliff), leave them [dying](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/dying), or result in them suffering a [condition](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/condition) or other negative effect. However, you can move them to provoke [opportunity attacks](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/opportunity-attack).

**Strained:** You take 1d6 damage and are [weakened](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/weakened) until the end of your [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn).
